display_long_description:
Slow down. Take aim. Enjoy the view.

Settle into a hillside deck overlooking a quiet, stylized valley. Hunt at your own pace with a scoped bolt-action rifle and hunting pistol, work their physical reloads, and read the wind before you squeeze the trigger.

A short optional intro teaches the rifle. Then chase bronze, silver and gold medals in 17 challenges, from long-range shots to five-round hunts, or simply enjoy Free Hunt. Choose Relaxed, Hunter or Expert: wind, aim sway, wary animals and shot placement grow with the difficulty.

Between shots, knock over cans, launch a flying disc, toss camp toys or pour yourself a coffee.

- Relaxed hunting and target practice from a stationary deck.
- Deer, boar, bison, foxes, rabbits, ducks and pheasants that hear your shots and move as herds.
- Hands-on rifle and pistol reloads, a holdover reticle, rangefinder and red-dot pistol sight.
- 17 challenges with medals, a trophy plaque, saved records and cosmetic upgrades earned through play.
- Three difficulty levels, midday or golden-hour light, and a mirrored left-handed layout.
- Adjustable table height for seated or standing play.
- An optional spatial radio for your own local MP3, WAV and Ogg music.

Single-player. Two tracked controllers required. English. Core gameplay works offline. No ads or real-money in-game purchases.

Music files are not included. The radio requests optional audio-library access. Protected streaming downloads and other apps' private files cannot be played.
